message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges based on facts.

Facts: Defendant Deng Mouyan ran appliance stores, during national appliance subsidy policy (home appliances to rural areas) from Dec 2008 to Nov 2012. He used fraudulent methods: underreporting purchases, false reports, duplicate claims to obtain subsidy funds totaling 96,964.80 yuan. Also bribed local finance officials (Liu Moumou 18,000 yuan + 2 air conditioners worth 5,000 yuan; Cao Mou info clerk 15,000 yuan) to get the false subsidy documents approved.

He voluntarily surrendered, returned illegal gains 120,000 yuan.

Thus crimes: fraud (specifically, obtaining state subsidies by false means) - likely "诈骗" (fraud) or "贪污" or "职务侵占"? He is not a public official, so not贪污. He is a private individual defrauding the state, so "诈骗" (fraud) is appropriate. Also "行贿" (bribery) because he gave bribes to officials. The list includes "行贿" (bribery) and "介绍贿赂" (facilitating bribery). He directly gave bribes, so "行贿". Also maybe "受贿" is for officials receiving bribes, not him. So "行贿". Also "诈骗" is used for fraud. In examples, they used "诈骗" for similar cases of fraudulent obtaining of funds. So answer: 诈骗;行贿.

Check if any other charge: "职务侵占" is for public officials misappropriating. Not applicable. "挪用公款" is misusing public funds, not. "贪污" is for public officials. So just two.

Thus final answer: [罪名]诈骗;行贿<eoa>
